summary: Median barrier on Moggill Road clearway; live lanes, nowhere to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Bush bank on the north side beyond the carriageway; houses across the road to the south.
drivers.access_and_room: Line follows the median barrier between carriageways; the adjacent lane is live traffic with no pull-off.
drivers.convention: Clearway tow-away signs on this stretch; moving cars only, none parked.

sun_shade: Open to sun; bush on the north bank shades the morning.
